purpose: Preserve backend emitter ownership while binding explicit uniform pipeline composition and versioned capabilities.
base: Exact separately identified four-lane backend-registry/1. Only the JavaScript lane is selected; other lanes remain exact.
derivation: Derivation/3 remains selected for original registry snapshots. Declaration-map builds select registry snapshot V2 and derivation/4, which requires the exact added declaration-position/map/recipe inventory while retaining shared uniform source signatures and backend-owned emission. No closed specialization-map product is added. For explicitly linked mode V3 and derivation/5 retain immutable unlinked printer/declaration outputs with separate linked identities and source-map link recipe.
verification: Bounded reader accepts only known selection versions and derivation identities, reconstructs the exact selected registry and selection bytes, and compares their identities. Bundle/context/query/archive binding remains exact. Static ownership audit checks emitter definitions for both the base registry and current uniform selection.
compatibility: Version-1 derivation code and record bytes remain unchanged. New capability derivations require distinct identities with retained readers. Registry/descriptor/bundle/graph schemas are not changed and no fifth lane is introduced.
remaining: Independent preservation, bootstrap diversity and full assurance

retainedDerivations.policy: Frozen backend-owned writer and portable declarations; no uniform lineage/source-map capabilities.
Adds real uniform declaration lineage and standalone source maps; expression origins, declaration maps and linking remain unsupported.
Explicit registry snapshot V2 declaration-map capability; source-writer coordinates and origin replay, no automatic linking or expression/type-token claims.
